lines.zh: 马蹄落石，声比我的呼吸响。
lines.en: Hooves strike stone, louder than my breath.

lines.zh: 我端坐鞍上，缰是骨做的。
lines.en: I sit tall in the saddle; the reins are bone.

lines.zh: 战马不用催，它知道方向。
lines.en: The steed needs no urging. It knows the way.

lines.zh: 甲片相碰，一路都在响。
lines.en: Plate knocks against plate the whole way.

lines.zh: 我压低骑枪，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I lower the lance and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 走过村口，狗先叫起来。
lines.en: Passing the village gate, the dogs bark first.

lines.zh: 马蹄绕过坟头，那是我旧日的位子。
lines.en: The hooves skirt a grave mound — my old seat.

lines.zh: 尸骑不必歇，马也不必。
lines.en: The rider does not rest. Neither does the horse.

lines.zh: 头盔里空着，风穿过去。
lines.en: My helm is empty; wind passes through.

lines.zh: 我沿旧道走，路还记得我。
lines.en: I take the old road. The road remembers me.

lines.zh: 披风拖在泥里，我不去管。
lines.en: My cloak drags in the mud. I let it.

lines.zh: 队形是两骑并行，我在左。
lines.en: We ride two abreast. I take the left.

lines.zh: 马汗是凉的，我的也是。
lines.en: The horse's sweat is cold. So is mine.

lines.zh: 每一步，铠甲都往下沉一寸。
lines.en: Every step, the armor sinks an inch lower.

lines.zh: 我坐在马上不动，像一尊铁像。
lines.en: I sit the horse without moving, like an iron statue.

lines.zh: 缰绳松着，马自己站着。
lines.en: The reins hang slack. The horse stands on its own.

lines.zh: 面甲后没有呼吸，只有回音。
lines.en: Behind the visor there is no breath, only echo.

lines.zh: 我擦剑，擦到刃上照见自己。
lines.en: I wipe the blade until it shows my reflection.

lines.zh: 葬我的那件披风，还披着。
lines.en: The cloak they buried me in is still on me.

lines.zh: 马低头啃草，草立刻枯了。
lines.en: The horse grazes; the grass withers at once.

lines.zh: 骨头在甲里动了一下，我把它按住。
lines.en: A bone shifts inside the plate. I press it back.

lines.zh: 远处有钟声，我记得那口钟。
lines.en: Bells in the distance. I remember that bell.

lines.zh: 我的马没有眼，却从不走错。
lines.en: My horse has no eyes, yet never missteps.

lines.zh: 我数着敌人的营地，一盏灯一盏灯。
lines.en: I count the enemy camp, lantern by lantern.

lines.zh: 尸巫在地底，我在等他的手势。
lines.en: The lich is below ground. I wait for his signal.

lines.zh: 甲缝里长出了黑苔。
lines.en: Black moss has taken root in my armor's seams.

lines.zh: 我试着回忆坐骑的名字，想不到。
lines.en: I try to recall my steed's name. Nothing comes.

lines.zh: 月亮升高了，马的影子变长。
lines.en: The moon rises; the horse's shadow lengthens.

lines.zh: 马蹄不动，我也不动。
lines.en: My mount does not stir, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 夜风穿过我的肋骨，凉的。
lines.en: Night wind slips between my ribs, cold.

lines.zh: 你的头抬得够高，正好在骑枪高度。
lines.en: Your head is high enough — lance height exactly.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，像看一块待耕的地。
lines.en: I look down at you like unplowed ground.

lines.zh: 面甲底下什么都没有，别找了。
lines.en: There is nothing behind the visor. Stop looking.

lines.zh: 你身上没有悚怖的印记。
lines.en: You bear no mark of the dread.

lines.zh: 你的剑鞘太干净了。
lines.en: Your scabbard is far too clean.

lines.zh: 我曾向活人低头，现在不。
lines.en: I once bowed to the living. Not anymore.

lines.zh: 报上名字，我好刻在碑上。
lines.en: Give me your name. I will carve it on a stone.

lines.zh: 你在数我的卫兵吗？我一个也没有。
lines.en: Counting my guards? I have none.

lines.zh: 我的马也在看你，它看得更准。
lines.en: My horse watches you too, and sees more clearly.

lines.zh: 头盔空着，我的目光从里面出来。
lines.en: The helm is empty; my gaze comes out of it.

lines.zh: 你和你身后的人，都一样高。
lines.en: You and the ones behind you stand equally tall.

lines.zh: 你的甲是新的，我的比你的旧。
lines.en: Your armor is new. Mine is much older.

lines.zh: 尸巫说，活人到这里就该停步。
lines.en: The lich says the living stop at this line.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，所以别等我眨眼。
lines.en: I do not blink, so do not wait for it.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，照见我的脸。
lines.en: You raise the torch high enough to find my face.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在面罩外结霜。
lines.en: Your breath frosts over outside your visor.

lines.zh: 我低头，是为了看清你的手。
lines.en: I lower my head to watch your hands.

lines.zh: 别再往前，你踏进了坟界。
lines.en: No further. You have stepped into the burial ground.

lines.zh: 甲凹了，骨头没断。
lines.en: The plate dents. The bone does not.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记你一笔。
lines.en: For that blow, I mark you down.

lines.zh: 我坐稳了，马也没退。
lines.en: I stay seated. The horse does not retreat.

lines.zh: 活人的力气，原来这么大。
lines.en: So this is how hard the living strike.

lines.zh: 剑砍在头盔上，声音很长。
lines.en: The sword rings on my helm, a long note.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里没有血，只有灰。
lines.en: No blood in my throat. Only ash.

lines.zh: 你打裂了面甲，我看得更清。
lines.en: You cracked the visor. I see better now.

lines.zh: 我抬手，甲片掉了一块。
lines.en: I raise my arm and a plate falls off.

lines.zh: 尸巫在远处记着这一下。
lines.en: The lich notes this blow from afar.

lines.zh: 我的马替我叫了一声。
lines.en: My horse makes the sound for me.

lines.zh: 肉？我的马都不吃。
lines.en: Meat? Even my horse will not touch it.

lines.zh: 活着时我也不收敌人的礼。
lines.en: Even alive, I took no gifts from enemies.

lines.zh: 把东西放下，人退到那边。
lines.en: Set it down. Take yourself over there.

lines.zh: 金币对我没用，棺材才是。
lines.en: Gold is useless to me. A coffin is not.

lines.zh: 你想收买一具空铠甲。
lines.en: You are trying to bribe empty armor.

lines.zh: 尸巫给的命令，比你的肉重。
lines.en: The lich's command weighs more than your meat.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只差一个对手。
lines.en: I am not hungry. I only lack an opponent.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，东西快掉了。
lines.en: Your hand shakes. You will drop it.

lines.zh: 收回去，别让它脏了我的路。
lines.en: Take it back. Do not let it dirty my road.

lines.zh: 我的马在闻，它闻出你的害怕。
lines.en: My horse sniffs, and finds your fear.

lines.zh: 你撞在马肩上，那比墙硬。
lines.en: You hit the horse's shoulder. Harder than a wall.

lines.zh: 让路，蹄子不收。
lines.en: Clear the road. The hooves do not slow.

lines.zh: 我坐得稳，撞不动。
lines.en: I sit steady. You will not move me.

lines.zh: 你擦到我的马镫，算是运气。
lines.en: You brushed my stirrup. Count that luck.

lines.zh: 人群挤过来，马就烦了。
lines.en: Crowds press in, and the horse grows restless.

lines.zh: 退到一边，铠甲有棱角。
lines.en: Step aside. This armor has edges.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏碎了你脚边的石。
lines.en: A hoof shatters the stone by your foot.

lines.zh: 我勒住马，你已经退了一半。
lines.en: I check the reins; you are already half-retreated.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我听到你骨头响。
lines.en: At the clash I hear the sound of your bones.

lines.zh: 别碰缰绳，那是我的手。
lines.en: Keep off the reins. Those are mine.

lines.zh: 我的婚约埋在三十年前的土里。
lines.en: My betrothal lies under thirty years of soil.

lines.zh: 骑士与战马，就是全部的同伴。
lines.en: Knight and steed: that is the whole of my company.

lines.zh: 尸巫造我，不为繁衍，为列阵。
lines.en: The lich made me to line up, not to breed.

lines.zh: 我记不起她的脸，只记得颜色。
lines.en: I cannot recall her face, only its color.

lines.zh: 同类之间只有军礼，没有别的。
lines.en: Among kin there is only salute, nothing else.

lines.zh: 我的马是唯一的伴，它不说话。
lines.en: My horse is my only company. It says nothing.

lines.zh: 婚姻是活人的事，我不参与。
lines.en: Marriage belongs to the living. I abstain.

lines.zh: 若她还等，也等成一堆白骨了。
lines.en: If she still waits, she waits as bones.

lines.zh: 尸骑成对只是行军，不是成亲。
lines.en: Dread knights pair to march, not to wed.

lines.zh: 别提这个，甲里会响。
lines.en: Do not raise it. Something rattles in my armor.

lines.zh: 我拾起地上的头盔，扣上。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen helm and buckle it on.

lines.zh: 这块铁能补我肩甲。
lines.en: This iron will patch my pauldron.

lines.zh: 金属我都要，别的一概不管。
lines.en: I take all metal and nothing else.

lines.zh: 土里插着半截剑，我拔了出来。
lines.en: A broken sword stands in the soil; I pull it free.

lines.zh: 低头很费劲，铠甲卡着。
lines.en: Bending is hard; the plate jams.

lines.zh: 马替我叼起来，它比我灵活。
lines.en: The horse fetches it. It is nimbler than I.

lines.zh: 这枚徽记我认得，是我军的。
lines.en: I know this badge. It was my company's.

lines.zh: 你的东西落在路中央。
lines.en: Your belongings lie in the middle of the road.

lines.zh: 我捡起来又扔掉，对我无用。
lines.en: I pick it up and drop it. Useless to me.

lines.zh: 披风上还挂着一枚旧扣。
lines.en: An old clasp still hangs on my cloak.

lines.zh: 列队，我数到三个活物。
lines.en: Form up. I count three living things.

lines.zh: 那匹马不是悚怖的，赶开它。
lines.en: That horse is not of the dread. Drive it off.

lines.zh: 尸巫的令：见活物，压过去。
lines.en: The lich's order: see the living, ride them down.

lines.zh: 我举起骑枪，前端压低。
lines.en: I raise the lance and tip it down.

lines.zh: 那个举旗的，先解决。
lines.en: The one with the banner. Him first.

lines.zh: 我的马已经转向，比我更早。
lines.en: My horse has already turned. Earlier than I.

lines.zh: 对面人多，那正好列阵。
lines.en: They have numbers. Good — a proper line.

lines.zh: 它躲到栅栏后，栅栏挡不住马蹄。
lines.en: It hides behind a fence. Fences fail against hooves.

lines.zh: 我盯上那个拿弓的。
lines.en: I fix on the one with the bow.

lines.zh: 活物在某处喘气，我听得清。
lines.en: Somewhere a living thing breathes. I hear it.

lines.zh: 先冲散他们，再一个一个来。
lines.en: Scatter them first, then take them one by one.

lines.zh: 我的马嗅到了，它先迈步。
lines.en: My horse has the scent. It steps first.

lines.zh: 这一战，我死了也算数。
lines.en: Win or lose, I have already died once.

lines.zh: 他们躲在火边，火挡不住尸体。
lines.en: They hide by the fire. Fire will not stop the dead.

lines.zh: 活人的气味，我认得。
lines.en: The smell of the living. I know it.

lines.zh: 又一个自己走进来的。
lines.en: Another one who walked in on his own.

lines.zh: 我绕到他们队伍侧面。
lines.en: I swing around to the flank of their line.

lines.zh: 马蹄声就是战鼓，让他们慌。
lines.en: Hoofbeats are my drum. Let them panic.

lines.zh: 我压枪，只等它抬头。
lines.en: I level the lance and wait for it to look up.

lines.zh: 他们背靠墙，退不了了。
lines.en: They are against the wall. No retreat left.

lines.zh: 我让马走慢些，让他们更怕。
lines.en: I slow the horse so they fear longer.

lines.zh: 拿盾的会先动，我看得出来。
lines.en: The one with the shield moves first. I can tell.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊声会被风带走。
lines.en: I do not shout. Wind carries shouts away.

lines.zh: 他们在等支援，我不会等。
lines.en: They wait for support. I will not.

lines.zh: 我把枪尖对准他胸口。
lines.en: I set the lance point on his chest.

lines.zh: 马在原地刨蹄，等我一夹腿。
lines.en: The horse paws the ground, waiting for my heel.

lines.zh: 他们分开了，正好各个击破。
lines.en: They split apart. Perfect for breaking one by one.

lines.zh: 这阵型我认得，我年轻时站过。
lines.en: I know this formation. I stood in one once.

lines.zh: 让他们先射，箭射不穿甲。
lines.en: Let them shoot first. Arrows will not pierce plate.

lines.zh: 尸巫在暗处看着，我要冲得漂亮。
lines.en: The lich watches from the dark. Make the charge clean.

lines.zh: 我把长枪放低了一寸。
lines.en: I drop the lance by an inch.

lines.zh: 你在退，退到墙角就没了。
lines.en: You keep backing up. The wall will end it.

lines.zh: 马在原地刨土，等我的令。
lines.en: The horse paws the ground, waiting on my word.

lines.zh: 我不急，反正你会累。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. You will tire first.

lines.zh: 骑枪贯入，我借着马势。
lines.en: The lance drives in, carried by the horse.

lines.zh: 第一击把盾牌钉在它胸口。
lines.en: The first blow nails the shield to its chest.

lines.zh: 我抽出剑，刃上全是缺口。
lines.en: I draw the sword. Its edge is all notches.

lines.zh: 马立起来，我用前蹄压下去。
lines.en: The horse rears and I drive its forehooves down.

lines.zh: 一剑横过，它的武器脱手。
lines.en: One sweeping cut and its weapon is gone.

lines.zh: 它砍我的腿，我早已在马上。
lines.en: It cuts at my legs. I am already mounted.

lines.zh: 我用肩甲撞它，铁比骨头硬。
lines.en: I ram with the pauldron. Iron beats bone.

lines.zh: 这一枪落了空，我立刻补一剑。
lines.en: The lance misses; the sword follows at once.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏下去，声音很闷。
lines.en: The hoof comes down. The sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 我把它挑起来，摔在马前。
lines.en: I lift it and throw it down before the horse.

lines.zh: 它抓我的缰绳，我把马带开。
lines.en: It grabs my reins. I pull the horse aside.

lines.zh: 甲上的凹坑又多了一个。
lines.en: One more dent in the armor now.

lines.zh: 我不追逃走的，先收拾站着的。
lines.en: I let the fleeing go and finish those standing.

lines.zh: 尸巫的剑法：一击，别多。
lines.en: The lich's swordsmanship: one strike, no more.

lines.zh: 枪尖穿过你的甲缝。
lines.en: The lance tip finds the gap in your plate.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏下，骨头发出脆响。
lines.en: Hooves come down, and bone answers with a crack.

lines.zh: 我从土里坐起，马在旁边等。
lines.en: I sit up out of the soil; the horse waits beside me.

lines.zh: 铠甲一件件扣上，是别人扣的。
lines.en: The armor buckles on piece by piece, by other hands.

lines.zh: 尸巫把缰绳塞进我手里。
lines.en: The lich presses the reins into my hand.

lines.zh: 马先睁眼，我才跟着睁眼。
lines.en: The horse opens its eyes first. Then I do.

lines.zh: 我试着站，膝盖记得怎么站。
lines.en: I try to stand. My knees remember how.

lines.zh: 铁锈味先回来，然后才是记忆。
lines.en: The taste of rust returns first, then memory.

lines.zh: 披风上一个洞，是穿透伤的位置。
lines.en: A hole in the cloak marks where the wound was.

lines.zh: 我上马，鞍是干的，马是冷的。
lines.en: I mount. The saddle is dry, the horse cold.

lines.zh: 旗子在远处，我朝它去。
lines.en: A banner stands far off. I ride toward it.

lines.zh: 甲缝里还有旧土，我不拍。
lines.en: Old soil still clings in my seams. I do not brush it.

lines.zh: 这是第几次醒来？我不数了。
lines.en: How many times have I woken? I stopped counting.

lines.zh: 我的军号角早锈穿了。
lines.en: My war horn rusted through long ago.

lines.zh: 马打响鼻，我们出发。
lines.en: The horse snorts. We set out.

lines.zh: 悚陵的门在身后关上。
lines.en: The dread tomb's gate closes behind me.

lines.zh: 我从悚陵的裂土里翻身上马。
lines.en: I climb out of the cracked soil of the Dread Mausoleum and into the saddle.

lines.zh: 墓碑倒了，是我推的。
lines.en: The headstone fell. I pushed it.

lines.zh: 冻土裂开，马先出来。
lines.en: The frozen ground splits, and the horse comes first.

lines.zh: 这片战场我又回来了。
lines.en: This battlefield has me back.

lines.zh: 雪落在铠甲的缝里，化了。
lines.en: Snow melts in the seams of my armor.

lines.zh: 旧主已死，誓言还在。
lines.en: The old master is dead. The oath is not.

lines.zh: 火烧铠甲，铁烫，我不烫。
lines.en: Fire heats the iron. I do not heat.

lines.zh: 连人带马跌下坡，甲全散了。
lines.en: Rider and horse tumble downslope, armor scattering.

lines.zh: 水里很静，我的马先沉。
lines.en: Underwater is quiet. My horse sinks first.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了我，马还站着。
lines.en: The blast throws me off. The horse still stands.

lines.zh: 箭插在甲缝里，差一点。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in a seam, a hair off.

lines.zh: 符文烧在胸甲上，很亮。
lines.en: Runes burn bright on my breastplate.

lines.zh: 我不会饿死，这算一种好处。
lines.en: I cannot starve to death. One advantage.

lines.zh: 雷落在我枪尖上，我举着它。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my lance tip. I hold it up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有马，只有我往下掉。
lines.en: No horse in the void. Only me, falling.
